title: Brand Context Builder
one_line: Interview once and write the shared context files that every other skill reads.
description: Interview once and write the shared context files that every other skill reads. Use at the start of any engagement, when skills keep asking the same questions, or when someone wants their AI tools to stop needing re explaining.
paragraph: Every skill in this catalog reads three files at the project root before it does anything: BRAND.md, ICP.md and VOICE.md. This skill runs the interview that produces them. It is the highest leverage twenty minutes in the whole catalog, because after it every other skill starts from a warm start instead of a questionnaire.
keywords: write my brand and icp files
requirements_summary: Needs no account, key or paid service: it works from the files, exports and answers you give it.
